notes:
Summary: Rapidloom builds a sub-ms edge inference fabric for ecommerce personalization and fraud reranking. They run 20M monthly queries across 150 regions (edge nodes). Priority: maintain p50 < 15ms, p99 < 80ms for 8k token-ish prompts; cost-sensitive — target <$0.0008 per request. Interested in Redwood Dedicated and Optimize for batching/caching/quantization guidance.

Key requirements:
- Very aggressive latency SLOs (p99 targets across geo).
- Workload mix: 70% short chat-like prompts (user intent), 25% reranking (candidate lists), 5% embeddings for fast lookup.
- Throughput burstiness: spikes 10-15x at promo windows; need burst capacity + autoscaling.
- Security: VPC with customer KMS, SOC2+audit logs, EU data residency for certain customers.
- Model preferences: open and reproducible weights (Llama-family / Mistral), small low-latency variants for edge; fallback to larger models for degraded-quality paths.
